role_separation: OPEN ONLY Event core member and its value fields after SHA verification; DO NOT open Occurrence extension, plant status, species or target ecological outcomes.

published_design.Event_identifier: year.trail_name.area.plot.line with trail name possibly containing '.'; split first and three rightmost pieces, leaving all middle pieces as trail ID
published_design.line25_only_plot1: This line exists only for edge plot 1 and must never be counted as equal effort relative to interior plots

exact_source_only_gate: Original Event id and source Event eventID must be globally one-to-one; fail on any repeat
island field must resolve exactly Terceira or São Miguel, never infer from coordinates or use area selection
year in eventID must match original Event year/eventDate
parse every source eventID, source area, plot and line from its published grammar; do not silently exclude unknown code
Event source value count is documented, no forced 260 from old v1.0 or 210 from v1.2
At least one complete matched triplet 50,100,150 for plot1 and for >=1 plot2/3 within each island; at least two source trails across archipelago. If not, STOP, no biology.
Do not force the published four-trail design to 4 if actual Event IDs show an incomplete field frame; report observed counts before decision
Summarize only group-level counts and number of eligible trail×year×area matched units; never include raw trail names or source EventIDs in released receipt

future_score_design_boundary.comparison: Within each trail×year×area group with fully matched common 50,100,150 cm lines, compare grouped per-line native and alien taxon detections for edge (plot1) versus interior (plots2,3).
future_score_design_boundary.aggregation: Line-level observations must first aggregate to physical plot; then to trail; never use 210 Event rows as independent replicates.
future_score_design_boundary.nested_risk: One Malhadas trail on São Miguel; no statistically independent island effect replication or uniform two-island transport claim.
future_score_design_boundary.unknown_nativeness: Stop if original Occurrence lacks unambiguous establishmentMeans class vocabulary; no postresponse relabeling.
future_score_design_boundary.not_causal: Trail exposure and stand condition observational; source metadata mentions separate trampling experiment but not linked or randomized within this archive.
